title: AI Spend Ledger Row
description: One row per AI subscription or API line, per month. Drives the subscription-replacement plan. Decisions: slm-learning-214 (GAD-owned inference becomes default replacement path), slm-learning-216 (AI spend ledger gates subscription downgrades).

vendor.description: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Cursor, RunPod, Together, HuggingFace, Modal, OpenRouter, etc.

product.description: Product name as it appears on the invoice (e.g. 'Claude Max', 'ChatGPT Plus', 'Gemini AI Pro', 'Cursor Pro', 'RunPod Flex GPU', 'Together API').

monthly_cost_usd.description: Actual or projected USD spent in this period.

monthly_cap_usd.description: Cap applied for this period (used vs phase budget).

role.description: Which replacement tier this line plays in the migration plan.

replacement_phase.description: Phase under the subscription replacement plan.

task_shapes_served.description: task_shape labels that this line currently serves (must match teachers.json vocabulary where possible).

replacement_target.description: Model id / route in registry that is intended to replace this line (e.g. 'qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct', 'kael-7b-tool-action-v1').

replacement_confidence.description: How confident we are that the replacement currently handles the task shape end-to-end.

successor_route.description: GAD gateway route id that absorbs this line's traffic when the line is downgraded.

monthly_calls_estimated.description: Approximate number of inference/chat calls per month.

downgrade_gate_status.description: 70%-handled-for-30-days frontier downgrade gate state per slm-learning-216.

downgrade_gate_window_days.description: Days of consecutive >=70% local handling observed for this task shape group.
